faqs.question: What is the difference between ⚔️🔥 and ⚔️🔥 in a softer register?
faqs.answer: ⚔️🔥 is the reaction-coded "name" — louder than a single emoji. ⚔️🔥 in a softer register carries a different register; check the partner emoji to read the precise shade.

faqs.question: What does ⚔️🔥 mean from a stranger?
faqs.answer: From a stranger ⚔️🔥 usually reads as a public-coded reaction. The combo is the same on comment sections regardless of relationship.

faqs.question: Should I use ⚔️🔥 in a complaint?
faqs.answer: ⚔️🔥 can punctuate a complaint-coded message but rarely fixes one. Pair with text that names the issue so the reaction-coded emoji is reinforcement, not noise.

faqs.question: What does ⚔️🔥 mean at the end of a sentence?
faqs.answer: Sandwiching ⚔️🔥 at the end of a sentence amplifies the sentence. The combo reads as "yes, and I really mean it" without writing it out.
